recipe: r21 (430.56 um relays, slab M8 pins)

roots.stream: hub_el/pll_r<k>: one region clock net per decision-C clock region, from the io_collective stream PLL via clk_root
roots.serial: io_collective/pll_serial -> clk_serial (0.9 GHz serial blocks, CDC hosts)
roots.links: forwarded clock with every link hop (fck_*, one per link relay / station)
roots.hbm: ctrl_<stack>/pll_hbm -> PHY clk + CDC hclk (976.6 MHz)

regions.rule: every region <= 5.25 mm extent (one H-tree within the 60 ps setup uncertainty)

io_budget.rule: element IO SDC: 90 ps on ports whose die hop stays in the region, 150 ps on ports whose hop crosses to another clock region; relays take the region clock where they sit

measured_insertion: results/rtl/budgets_20261006/measured_insertion.json (main): the station / relay family s2_cst_hm40 / s2_chead_hm40 ETMs carry their own insertion; the die STA uses ideal region roots + element ETMs (propagated inside)
